posts.raw_content:
Copy Paste from Sharon Orr’s facebook post. Linked below 

My name is Sharon Orr and I am a resident of East Pennsboro, where I live with my 15 year-old granddaughter.  My name has surfaced in the media this week as “Janelle Stelson’s neighbor who called the cops because Stelson was walking around outside naked.”

In my efforts to avoid any of this circus, I did not yet file charges on the August 14 incident because - as I stated to police when I called - 1) I didn’t want a media circus in or near my home, 2) my intent was not to inflict damage on Ms. Stelson or her campaign, and 3) I just needed her behavior to stop. My granddaughter has special needs, mimics what she sees, and protecting her welfare and safety was and remains my paramount concern. After other incidents of Ms. Stelson’s open nudity,  I needed it to finally stop.  

The Aug. 14 incident happened in broad daylight, when I was outside with my two dogs. When I saw Ms. Stelson naked outside - very close to my yard/home - I immediately yelled inside to my granddaughter, “(NAME!) stay inside with your dog!”  I could not again risk her seeing this display and starting to emulate the behavior as she has the propensity to do because of her challenges. 

Ms. Stelson knows my granddaughter (in fact, was paid by the landlord to bring in Stelson’s trashcans), and knows she has special needs. 

After I ensured that my grandchild was inside/out of view, I took a photo from my kitchen window of Ms. Stelson leaning naked on her deck railing as validation for the police (which is part of the official complaint) and called the non-emergency number.  I openly said, “look, full disclosure my neighbor is Janelle Stelson”  to avoid them any hassle, but that I just needed someone to come out so her behavior stops.

After police spoke with her, the one officer said “I don’t think she’ll do that again - here or anywhere else,” but asked if I wanted to press charges. I replied that I did not - for the reasons mentioned above - and I just needed it all to stop.”

Instead of taking the police warning as a wake-up call, Ms. Stelson has continued to expose herself in view of my home, as recently as October 14th.

I want it to stop!

Becoming the centerpiece of online bullying, aggressive press calls, and harassing media visits to my home was everything I tried to avoid. But now, since Ms. Stelson has decided to release and tarnish my name, my integrity, my reputation, and my honor with her breathtaking lies and harassment, she leaves me no choice.  I will no longer tolerate her personal attacks and besmirching of my character - which has been above reproach for my entire life, in and outside of my military service. I’m a Veteran, widow, and grandmother of a child who is the epicenter of my life, and I will no longer tolerate Ms. Stelson’s lewd and self-righteous behavior, lack of judgment, and personal attacks on me, my character, and integrity, and am rethinking my decision to press charges.
